summary: Production dependency pinned to a mutable GitHub fork (libsignal → tenka-san/libsignal-node)
details: package.json declares the production dependency `libsignal` with the value `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node`, a GitHub shorthand that carries no commit SHA, no tag, and no semver constraint. On `npm install`, npm resolves this specifier to the current HEAD of that personal fork, fetches whatever source is at HEAD at install time, and executes any lifecycle scripts the fork ships. Whoever controls `tenka-san/libsignal-node` can push arbitrary code to that branch at any time and that code will run on every machine that installs @poucode/baileys@2.0.4. The resolved source is a personal fork unrelated to the upstream Baileys libsignal dependency, and the specifier is both off-registry and unpinned, so the installed bytes are not covered by the npm registry integrity hash for @poucode/baileys and can change silently between installs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
